negative_cases.title: unsupported source/renderer pair

context.route: GeoPhys native RayTraceEngine on unsupported visual representation or PickCube free cube with current cross projection

negative_cases.input: required task RGB and unsupported free-body/asset mapping
negative_cases.reply: static admission says unsupported or unknown with reason before native effect
negative_cases.disposition: reject build; never claim capability from registration or camera shape

negative_cases.title: stale episode/state/camera frame
negative_cases.input: consumer presents old borrowed frame after reset/camera reconfiguration
negative_cases.reply: identity validator rejects stale episode/state/config generation
negative_cases.disposition: fault required task RGB; never substitute prior image

negative_cases.title: App update advances physics
negative_cases.reply: physics clock delta detected or public render-only/pause path is proven
negative_cases.disposition: reject route if update cannot be separated; no hidden transition

negative_cases.title: required capture failure after physics completed
negative_cases.input: camera failure after step interval advanced
negative_cases.reply: fault receipt preserves completed interval, state clock and partial effects
negative_cases.disposition: no normal transition, old frame, zero image or rollback claim; require rebuild/reset/close

negative_cases.title: borrowed or async image consumed before completion/expiry
negative_cases.input: Recorder/vector return reads image before fence or after next buffer write
negative_cases.reply: pending completion must be waited on before access; a still-valid completed lease may be copied/retained before expiry; an expired lease is rejected and cannot be repaired by reading the overwritten buffer

negative_cases.title: duplicate close or old lease release
negative_cases.input: session A close called twice while B still active; stale g1 lease release arrives
negative_cases.reply: A close idempotently releases only its lease; stale generation is rejected; App stays open until last lease owner releases

negative_cases.title: worker frame broadcast or terminal/reset identity mix
negative_cases.input: single worker image duplicated to both rows or terminal frame assigned new episode
negative_cases.reply: row/camera/state identity mismatch rejected; terminal frame retained before mask reset
negative_cases.disposition: env-0 advances in the batched interval and remains unchanged only during the following mask reset; env-1 returned obs is reset frame, info stores old terminal_observation and reset_info

execution_note: All cases were checked as design values only. No provider import, native build, window, runtime, solver, GPU, physics step or implementation test was run.
